title: Saudi Arabia Landscape Post-Processing: Exposure, Bracketing, Focus Stacking, and Zone-Based Photoshop Techniques

summary: This tutorial-style walkthrough analyzes Saudi Arabia landscape imagery through a photographer’s workflow, focusing on evaluating proper exposure and dynamic range, leveraging multi-shot techniques such as focus stacking and exposure blending, and executing a zone-based post-processing approach in RAW and Photoshop. The speaker emphasizes starting with correct exposure to maximize detail, using bracketing when needed, and isolating processing to sky, mountains, and foreground zones. The workflow then proceeds through a hands-on Photoshop routine (dodging, whitening, color grading, edge and feathered selections, and careful sun/star enhancement) to craft a cohesive look with a strong sun-beam focal point, all while managing flare, color balance, and depth through layer separation and selective adjustments.

sections.title: Zone-based post-processing concept

process one zone at a time to preserve overall balance
sections.description: The workflow is framed around processing distinct zones in isolation, then combining them to maintain natural transitions and avoid global edits that degrade any one area.
